register_acc_op: register a new acc op function using the register_acc_op decorator
register_acc_op_mapping: register a mapping from a non-acc operator to an acc operator using the decorator
register_custom_acc_mapper_fn: register a custom mapping function to normalize an FX node to acc ops
normalize: normalize a torch FX GraphModule by replacing nodes with registered acc ops
get_normalized_kwargs: get normalized kwargs for an FX node using arg replacement tuples
